name: Bejeweled
description_html:
Eye-catching bouquet of purple anemones and assorted roses.

This playful bunch is guaranteed to make the whole place shimmer. Purple anemones, peach carnations, and roses in a few sweet shades of pink glisten like precious jewels against white spray roses and eucalyptus.  

Pro Tip: Your flowers will arrive fresh in our recyclable Bouqs box and may still be in bud form. This maximizes their shelf life, so they’ll last as long as possible! Please allow 2-3 days for your new buds to open and reach full bloom.

Please Note: While we always try our best to match the bouquet pictured, we remain dedicated to fresh, high-quality flowers. Occasionally substitutions including color variation or supplemental flower type may occur to ensure you receive our farmers’ freshest possible selection.

Due to local restrictions, this Bouq cannot be delivered to Hawaii.

name: In the Clouds
description_html:
This elegant bouquet pairs white ranunculus with anemones.

Be a real hero with this epic Bouq fit for anyone In the Clouds. Both Zeus and Poppins-approved, these anemones and ranunculus give all the idyllic cumulus cloud vibes. Bring a beautiful day home — no need for an airplane, a magic carpet, or a flying umbrella.

name: Honeymoon
description_html:
Bouquet with light pink and purple roses with white anemone and lavender limonium.
